query_return_interpretation.scope: These nonzero query returns mean unfinished asynchronous work; they are not evidence of an illegal address, numerical failure, or the reason the worker exited.
query_return_interpretation.documentation_caveat: The installed mcEventQuery comment reverses ready/not-ready prose; preserve that contradiction. The enum maps 600 to mcErrorNotReady, mcStreamQuery and mcEventElapsedTime comments describe unfinished work. This record does not use the code as a crash diagnosis or add a runtime check.
